<issue>
Cell text replacement produces reversed text

#### Description

When setting text content on a table cell using the `text` property, the text appears reversed in the document.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
from docx import Document

# Create a new document with a table
doc = Document()
table = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=1)
cell = table.cell(0, 0)

# Set cell text
cell.text = "Hello World"

# Save and check the document - text appears as "dlroW olleH"
doc.save('test.docx')
```

The expected behavior is that the cell should contain "Hello World" but instead it contains the text reversed as "dlroW olleH".

This affects any text assignment to table cells and makes the library unusable for basic table text operations.
</issue>
